hypothesis: Investigating the most vulnerable premise before detailed drafting reduces rejected drafting and correction while preserving full ordinary research/review.
selection: From existing TODO worklist: only_judgment_left=yes; provisional=no; draft clauses<=4; sources_ok; conflicts empty; fr_originals_high; no canonical/frozen owner/reservation; first three >=2-member candidate-ending groups in worklist order with distinct ending actors; take first two. No source conclusions inspected to pick outcomes. Prior exact-ID research search found no producer/reviewer attempt. Shared unlock list inspected; authorized method comparison selects ordinary judgment work instead of acquisition campaign.
matching_limits: Same suggested ending actor and draft clause count; actual compiled inventories and legal questions can differ. One material undercount retained; no post-outcome replacement. Restricted simple decided sample, not representative campaign.

randomization.algorithm: Python random.Random(20261026).randrange(2), one draw per fixed pair

ordinary: Competent existing AGENTS/claim-kit ordinary production, including mandatory earlier-ending, scope, independent-command, savings and D6 checks; choose normal research sequence.
treatment: After original/inventory and prior-work reading, state candidate ending and its most vulnerable premise; investigate that premise with relevant primary evidence before detailed lifecycle drafting. Continue all ordinary research and review; this replaces ordering, not an extra reviewer. Retain contemporaneous early test in journal before final draft.
execution: Six separate fresh OpenAI contexts, one per order; identical available tools/code/evidence/rules; no exposure to other producers or allocations. One common native sealed packet; each writes only own subdirectory/row exports; deterministic row merge then native apply/batch-check/complete. Reviewers blinded to allocation where possible, same-family independent AI, no human certification. No status adoption.

limits.policy: Equal bounded research budgets. Stop early on documented source blocker, queue through existing contract, preserve exact incomplete work. If budget reached, checkpoint honestly; no source exhaustion inferred. No hidden replacement cases. Continue available required review/corrections within cap; report censored results.

success_rule: Worthwhile preliminary signal requires >=30% lower summed observed producer+review+correction worker elapsed for treatment, all three pairs with both histories upheld at unchanged requirements, no material uncaught controls, and no unresolved quality deficit. Six cases cannot prove campaign saving. If any histories remain incomplete, report fixed six-case outcomes and censored costs; do not divide by successful cases to assert savings. Include actual mechanical, acquisition and shared setup/integration/publication costs separately; net and campaign payback unknown absent population/cost coverage.
usage: Observed worker occupancy is not active labor. Tokens/cache/cash unavailable unless actual tool/session telemetry provides them; never estimate from bytes or generate fictitious baseline.
no_new_runtime: No new generic tools, mandatory gates or broad workflow launch. Canonical claims filed only exact reviewed/eligible via completion; otherwise isolated proposed research retained. Existing claims/statuses/holds/codebook/census unchanged.
